objective: Independently verify the manual-input boundary correction (attempts 01+02) against C-AC-08/C-AC-26/C-AC-32 and Root adjudication, and that automation holds were not weakened.
required_tests: Manual input (user owner) through real PersistentShell and through the real backend/ui_v1 path: editing keys, ESC sequences, Ctrl-C/D/Z/U at the prompt and inside user-launched foreground programs (cat, python3 -q, sleep, a program that spawns its own child pgrp e.g. `sh -c 'sleep 30'`), then submitting further lines; bash and dash.

Automation holds NOT weakened: after any editing/control byte and while the line state is uncertain, automatic submit/can_dispatch and claim_manager must still be refused with reasons; wb-handoff typed with editing keys must not be accepted as a clean handoff; only the authenticated READY/CONTROL_READY paths clear state. No timer/output-based reset.
Unobservable/foreign target: foreground group outside the shell session or unobservable -> manual input held with visible reason; control channel loss -> held; parent identity drift -> held.
Gap1: wb-handoff rejected by incompatible hook/trap -> subsequent authenticated READY -> manual input to the live prompt works, automation still held.

Gap2: confirmed takeover of an automation-launched foreground run: editing/control bytes reach the experiment, lifecycle does not become unknown, confirmed_target persists; experiment keeps running; return path (input barrier -> control_returned -> manual prompt -> wb-handoff -> claim -> new submit) still works and old requests are never replayed.

Temp-dir residue: after a normal confirmed shutdown of backend and of PersistentShell, no /tmp/cw03-g2-* (shell-init) directory remains; report whether the per-run leftover observed by the worker comes from SIGKILL-ed backend tests only.
Regressions: tests/terminal, tests/gates/g2_shell (discover + canonical matrix), tests/backend, tests/contracts, tests/lifecycle, tests/gates/g4_lifetime.
constraints: Independent test-only owner; production frozen; no docs/workflow/ledger edits; no tmux/herdr; no credentials; exact-identity cleanup; leaks fail.
report: candidate_ready or needs_reroute with evidence; added cases/counts; per-requirement verdict; frozen hashes of changed production files start=end; residue.
